D: Logan travels to Japan to say goodbye to a man he once saved and gets caught up in a family fight.
P: Serve the snacks when Logan fights on top of the bullet train.
S: Sushi rice triangles around flaked grilled salmon, wrapped in nori
Sushi rice shaped into triangles around flaked salted salmon, wrapped in strips of nori and packed into a bento box with pickled ginger.
Chicken thigh skewers grilled with a soy and mirin glaze
Chicken thigh pieces threaded onto skewers, grilled and basted with soy, mirin and sugar simmered down until sticky, scattered with spring onion.

Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, with soy and rice vinegar to dip. Salt 200g finely chopped wombok for 10 minutes and squeeze dry. Mix with 300g pork mince, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 1 grated garlic clove, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat them closed. Fry flat side down in oil over medium heat for 2 minutes until golden, add 80ml water, cover and steam 3 minutes until dry. Serve with 3 tbsp soy mixed with 2 tbsp rice vinegar and chilli oil.
M: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs
Ramen noodles in a rich pork and miso broth with slices of braised pork belly, soft-boiled eggs and spring onion.

Salmon fillets glazed with soy, mirin and sugar, grilled until sticky, served with steamed rice and a quick pickled cucumber salad. Simmer 4 tbsp soy, 4 tbsp mirin, 2 tbsp sake or water and 1 tbsp sugar for 3 minutes until syrupy. Thinly slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers, salt for 10 minutes, squeeze and toss with 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and sesame seeds. Cook 1.5 cups short grain rice. Pan-fry 4 salmon fillets skin side down for 4 minutes, flip, cook 2 minutes, then pour in the glaze and bubble until sticky. Serve with the rice and cucumber.
W: Matcha ice cream with sesame brittle
Vanilla ice cream folded with matcha, topped with sesame brittle

Vanilla ice cream rippled with matcha, scooped into small bowls and topped with shards of black sesame brittle and a drizzle of honey. Soften 1L vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Whisk 2 tbsp matcha powder with 2 tbsp hot water into a paste and fold through the ice cream, then refreeze for 1 hour. For brittle, melt 100g caster sugar in a pan without stirring until golden, stir in 3 tbsp black sesame seeds and pour onto baking paper. Cool 15 minutes and break into shards. Scoop the ice cream and top with brittle and a little honey.
K: Warm sake with yuzu and ginger
Sake warmed with sliced ginger and yuzu

Sake gently warmed with fresh ginger and a splash of yuzu juice, poured into small cups. Hot green tea with yuzu for anyone not drinking. Pour 500ml sake into a heatproof jug with 4 thin slices of ginger. Stand the jug in a saucepan of hot water over low heat for 8 minutes until warm to touch, about 50C, never boiling. Stir in 2 tsp yuzu juice and 1 tsp honey. Pour into small cups. For non-drinkers, brew green tea at 80C and add the same yuzu and honey.

ingredients.item: firm tofu, cut into thick slices

steps.text: Soak the shiitake in 250 ml hot water for 20 minutes, then slice, keeping the soaking water.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then add the soy sauce, brown sugar and 3 tbsp water and simmer until sticky.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Simmer the vegetable stock with the shiitake and soaking water for 10 minutes, then whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build the bowls with tofu, eggs, nori and spring onion.
